title: AFSWP established at Sandia Base

tellings.quote: the AFSWP was established in 1947 at Sandia Base in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

plain: In 1947 the military set up a special weapons project, known by its initials as AFSWP, at Sandia Base in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a center for handling atomic weapons. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this and links it to James Forrestal, the defense chief of that time. He brings it up to show where secret programs of that era were based.
